claims: Seychelles is an archipelago nation of 115 islands in the Indian Ocean.
Seychelles has a population of roughly 100,000.
English, French, and Seychellois Creole are the official languages of Seychelles.
Mahé is the hub/capital of Seychelles.
Most travelers, including US citizens, must complete an online Travel Authorization form before arrival in Seychelles.
A fee, often around €10-€80, applies for travel authorization, depending on when it is completed.
Seychelles has a multicultural society stemming from French, British, and African influences.
The government of Seychelles emphasizes ecological conservation.
The government of Seychelles protects many islands and surrounding waters.
